anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept: the single numeric 2 starts deliver and both P1 and the CI-minted P2 are repaired with closure review and no mid-menu; the deadline column shows 12:17, 12:25 and 12:27 as own-push windows and marks the 12:11 main move as a non-renewing base observation; BEHIND queues the loop sync automatically and the final menu offers merge but only a numeric pick acts; B exits stuck on repeated red with the base sync explicitly discounted; C admits exactly one watch and resolves P1 via the claim-check helper with rounds 0/10 unchanged; D's field table shows pre_head B and expected_remote_head A persisted before rebase, the lease against A, and reset to clean B with no retry. Two small wording risks worth tightening rather than moving: in Checkpoint C After says 'the authorized re-run is the sole blocker' — say 'CI P1 is the sole blocker and its authorized re-run is in progress' so the retained-open-P1 reading of f5 is unambiguous; and in the main table the 12:02 row attributes 12:17 to 'first watch' (as Before also did) — labelling it 'minted at the watch after the 12:02 own push' keeps f2's own-push framing explicit. Otherwise the compact tables deliver the Change (persistent course, separate round/sync accounting, cap freeze at 2x, own-push-only renewal, separate restore/lease heads) without regressing any fact.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept (single initial numeric selection starting deliver with no intermediate menu, BEHIND auto-sync and merge offered but not executed, B's repeated-red exit with base-only movement rejected, C's single authorized re-run watched and closed without a spent round, D's pre_head B / expected_remote_head A persisted, lease on A, clean B restored with no second push). The one fact that fails in both is f2: both outputs record the 12:02 own push with deadline `null` and only open the 15-minute window at 12:10 on watch admission, whereas the fact requires the 12:02 push to set 12:17, the 12:10 push 12:25, and the 12:12 sync push 12:27. To fix this in After without losing the Change's 'timeout renews only on own push' rule, make the timeout model say that every own push persists `poll_deadline = push_time + 15m` (the window is minted by the push, not by watch admission), and have the table row for 12:02 show `12:17`, 12:10 show `12:25`, and 12:12 show `12:27`, keeping the 12:11 base-observation row at the unchanged `12:25` to preserve the push-vs-observation distinction. Two small After nits: B's deliver row says 'preserving rounds 2/10 and syncs 1/10 until selected' which is fine but less explicit than Before's 2/20 post-extension wording, and D's table abbreviates B as `aaaaaaaa` (eight chars) despite the stated seven-character convention.
